# Bounded fallback ladder against provider-side model retirement (issue #591).
#
# resolve-model.sh resolves the requested (pinned) model against the live
# registry (https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models) before every agent run and
# substitutes the first live rung below when the pin is dead. At runtime the
# shared runner retries the next rung once per rung on a provider "Model not
# found" and fails the step loudly when the whole ladder is dead, so a
# provider retirement can no longer kill every arm at once nor conclude green.
#
# Rules for rungs:
#   - one model ref per line, order = fallback preference, comments allowed;
#   - every rung MUST be a free-tier model ending in "-free" (the CreditsError
#     two-knob guard, audit R6; non-free lines are ignored by the resolver);
#   - verify each rung against the live registry before adding or reordering
#     (the Auditor surveys the model ecosystem daily and proposes updates).
opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free
opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free
opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free
